clause_text: This Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on this 15th day of October, 2025.
The Effective Date of this Agreement shall be the date on which both parties have signed it.
This Agreement is by and between Acme Corp. ('Disclosing Party') and Beta Industries ('Receiving Party').
The obligations of confidentiality under this Agreement shall expire three (3) years from the Effective Date.
Each party agrees not to solicit or hire any employee of the other party during the term of this Agreement and for one year thereafter.
This Agreement shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the laws of the State of Delaware.
The Receiving Party agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Disclosing Party against any and all claims arising from unauthorized disclosure of Confidential Information.
Receiving Party shall not assign this Agreement or any rights hereunder without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.
Neither party shall disparage the other party, its products, or its employees in any public forum or to any third party.
This Agreement contains the entire agreement between the parties regarding the subject matter hereof.
Provider grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable, revocable license to access the SaaS Platform during the subscription term.
This license is strictly personal, non-transferable, and may not be sublicensed or assigned to any third party.
Customer agrees to pay a minimum annual commitment of USD 120,000, billed in equal monthly installments.
Customer agrees that the monthly data traffic shall not exceed 10 Terabytes per month.
Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience at any time by giving the other party at least ninety (90) days prior written notice.
Except for breach of confidentiality, in no event shall either party's aggregate liability exceed the total amounts paid under this Agreement in the twelve months preceding the claim.
Provider's liability for direct damages arising out of a breach of data security obligations shall be completely uncapped and unlimited.
Provider warrants that the SaaS Platform will perform substantially in accordance with the user documentation for a period of ninety (90) days from deployment.
This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive terms of one (1) year unless either party provides notice of non-renewal at least 60 days before the end of the term.
Notice period to terminate or prevent automatic renewal of this agreement is 60 days prior to expiration.
The Employee agrees that during their employment and for a period of twelve (12) months following termination, they will not engage in any competitive business activity.
The Employee shall not solicit, contact, or attempt to induce any customers of the Company to cease doing business with the Company.
All inventions, software, and intellectual property developed by the Employee during the course of employment shall belong solely and exclusively to the Company.
Nothing in this Agreement shall prevent the Employee from owning less than two percent (2%) of the public shares of any competing company.
Either party may terminate this employment relationship at-will upon providing 30 days written notice to the other party.
If the Company terminates this Agreement due to a Change of Control, the Employee shall be entitled to a lump-sum severance payment equal to six (6) months of salary.
The Employee agrees to maintain professional indemnity insurance coverage of at least USD 1,000,000 during their employment.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of California.
In the event of a breach of the non-compete clause, the Employee shall pay liquidated damages of USD 50,000.
Employee shall receive a base salary of INR 1,500,000 per annum, paid monthly.
The Tenant shall pay a monthly base rent of INR 100,000, payable on the first day of each month.
The Landlord covenants and agrees that the Tenant shall have quiet enjoyment and exclusive possession of the premises.
Tenant shall have a Right of First Refusal to lease any adjacent space that becomes vacant in the building.
The Tenant shall pay monthly utility charges based on consumption metrics, and the landlord shall pay property taxes.
The Landlord shall provide structural maintenance and major repairs to the roof and foundation.
This Lease Agreement is dated as of September 1, 2025.
The term of this Lease shall be five (5) years, commencing on the Commencement Date.
If the Tenant defaults on rent payment, Landlord may terminate this Lease immediately and re-enter the premises.
Tenant shall keep in force public liability insurance of not less than INR 2,000,000 naming Landlord as additional insured.
Neither party shall be liable to the other for indirect or consequential damages.
Developer hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in and to the custom software deliverables to the Client.
Developer and Client shall jointly own all intellectual property rights in any generic software components developed during the project.
Developer grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide license to use Developer's pre-existing software library embedded in the deliverables.
Developer shall deposit the source code of the software into an independent escrow agent registry for the benefit of the Client.
Each party covenants not to sue the other party for patent infringement regarding the technology used in the project.
During the term and for one year thereafter, Client shall not solicit or hire Developer's software engineers.
This Agreement does not create any rights in or benefits for any third party under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act.
Developer warrants that the software will be free from defects for a period of ninety (90) days after acceptance.
Developer represents that the billing rates charged to Client are no less favorable than those charged to any other customer.
Developer agrees to provide post-termination transition services for up to 30 days at Developer's standard rates.
This agreement shall remain in effect for a period of 4 years after signature date.
